title: torch.erf spelling -> builtin GELU op (no ERF builtin exists)

rewrite.from: torch.erf in the exact-GELU formula - converter emits a 96-op clamp+rational approximation (MINIMUM/MAXIMUM/DIV + MUL/ADD chain)
rewrite.equivalence_evidence: erf = erf; the emitted approximation is itself the numerics change, the builtin op is closer to exact

measurement.probe: probe_fx_erf (erf chain in the gelu slot) vs probe_fx_relu (empty-slot control) = 3.79x; real-model anchor: DINOv2-S erf-op build 41.9 ms vs tanh-chain 85.9 (exp 4)

scope: the erf chain is WORSE than the tanh chain (54.0 ms) - torch.erf is the single worst GELU spelling on this NPU
notes: full fusion-slot family (same chain, one op X): LOGISTIC 18.5 / EXP 20.6 / POW 22.3 / empty 23.7 / MAXIMUM 25.3 / ABS 26.4 / SQRT,RSQRT 31.6 / TANH 54.0 / erf-chain 89.8. LOGISTIC/EXP/POW beat the empty control - HTP pattern choice is non-monotonic, do not model as baseline+op-cost
